data.name: Backrooms Dream with Tung Tung Tung Sahur
data.detailed_description:
Wake up. Go to work. Repeat. Something is wrong.

Backrooms Dream with Tung Tung Tung Sahur is a short first-person psychological horror game about a man trapped inside a strange and unstable dream loop.

After a painful divorce, the main character lives a lonely and empty life. He has no close friends, no real purpose, and every day feels exactly the same. But one morning, his routine begins to break. The hotel corridors feel different. Rooms change. Reality starts to twist. And every time he tries to wake up, the nightmare begins again.

Each day becomes stranger than the last.

Escape the loop before it consumes you

Explore surreal and psychedelic levels where nothing feels stable. Some areas look like abandoned hotels, while others take you into completely different nightmares: endless corridors, strange portals, maze-like spaces, eerie pools, and distorted places that should not exist.

To escape, you must complete unusual tasks, solve puzzles, collect strange objects, and survive dangerous encounters. Sometimes you will need to run. Sometimes you will need to observe what is wrong. Sometimes you will not know if what you see is real.

Who is Sahur?

A strange wooden figure known as Tung Tung Tung Sahur keeps appearing inside the dream. At first, it feels distant. Then it gets closer. It watches, chases, interrupts, and slowly becomes a bigger part of the nightmare.

Why did Sahur appear in your life?
What does it want?
And why can’t you wake up?

Features

  • First-person psychological horror gameplay

  • Surreal Backrooms-inspired dream environments

  • A story about loneliness, routine, divorce, and losing touch with reality

  • Multiple strange levels with different rules and visual styles

  • VHS-style atmosphere and disturbing liminal spaces

  • Chase sequences, maze escapes, portals, and puzzle-based progression

  • Anomaly-style sections where you must notice what is wrong

  • Short but intense horror experience focused on tension and atmosphere

Can you break the cycle?

Every day feels familiar, but something is always changing. The dream is becoming more unstable, Sahur is appearing more often, and the way out is never clear.

Find the truth. Survive the nightmare. Wake up.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains horror elements and tense situations, including being pursued by hostile enemies. Some scenes may include mild depictions of blood and implied violence as part of the story.
